feature_descriptions.Joint_Error: Euclidean distance between student and teacher normalized joint positions (torso-relative)
feature_descriptions.Joint_Cosine: Cosine similarity between student and teacher position vectors
feature_descriptions.Velocity_Error: Euclidean distance between student and teacher velocity vectors (frame-to-frame delta)

model_input.name: features
model_input.note: Rows correspond to joints evaluated at current frame. Features: [Joint_Error, Joint_Cosine, Velocity_Error]

frame_scoring.note: frame_score = sum of Predicted_Pass * weight. frame_pass = (frame_score >= 7.1)
